$comment: Reviewer registry for the review-attestation gate and triage queue on mlorentedev/web.
Matches both coderabbitai (advisory) and github-actions (PR-Agent on NaN inference).
Release PRs are exempted by signature (.release-please-manifest.json, CHANGELOG.md).

reviewers.why: ADVISORY: its review still attests, but its DECLINE yields pending rather than refused.
review_markers: No actionable comments were generated in the recent review

reviewers.why: PR-Agent posts as github-actions via GITHUB_TOKEN and publishes through the comments API.

escape.label: merged-unreviewed
escape.why: Proceeding on an unreviewed PR is allowed; proceeding SILENTLY is not.

signatures.name: release-please
signatures.why: The release PR restates commits already on master, each reviewed when it merged.

triage.why: The heading under which pr-review-triage records its per-item dispositions.
